Every GeoJSON feature in the curated hierarchical per-class files carries a set of **PSGC
enrichment properties** alongside the original NAMRIA source attributes.

## PSGC enrichment properties

Each feature carries:

- `psgc_id` — stable entity URI
- `psgc_code` — 10-digit Philippine Standard Geographic Code
- `psgc_name` — canonical name
- `psgc_status` — e.g. `existing`
- `match_confidence` — `exact` | `huc_map` | `fuzzy`

## Source NAMRIA attributes

The original NAMRIA shapefile attributes are preserved on each feature (e.g. `ADM4_EN`,
`ADM4_PCODE`, `ADM3_EN`, …), so a feature can be joined back to either the PSGC or the NAMRIA
identifier space.

## Match confidence

The `match_confidence` field records how a feature's PSGC code was resolved:

- `exact` — direct PSGC code match
- `huc_map` — resolved via the [HUC mapping](../references/huc-mapping.qmd)
- `fuzzy` — matched by name similarity (lower confidence)

See [HUC mapping](../references/huc-mapping.qmd) for why HUCs need special handling, and
[coverage](coverage.qmd) for per-level match statistics.
